reserves.name: Physical gold bars (London Good Delivery, LBMA-accredited London vaults)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Paxos Trust Company, N.A. and allocated gold held in LBMA-accredited London vaults

reserveReview.rationale: Paxos states that each PAXG represents one fine troy ounce of allocated LBMA Good Delivery gold held in London vaults and publishes monthly independent attestations. The reviewed product and transparency materials support a complete physical-gold reserve category without a separate asset-type split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Paxos PAXG product, custody, and monthly-attestation disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve asset is identified and independently attested, but the reviewed public pages do not provide a provider-level allocation of the gold across vault accounts.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Physical gold bars (London Good Delivery, LBMA-accredited London vaults)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Allocated physical gold is an exogenous commodity reserve rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Paxos custody, allocated storage in LBMA-accredited London vaults, and monthly KPMG attestations are disclosed, but current vault providers, provider-level gold shares, and explicit rehypothecation terms were not established in the reviewed sources.
